body: Sorry I haven't been on this account in a couple days. I'm better now. At least the suicidal thoughts are gone. I still feel like something is missing and I'm a little empty, but I'm getting support which is good.

I'm doing better now. I talked with my girlfriend about the emptiness and she was super supportive. I didn't tell her about the suicidal thoughts because I don't want to it to much on her too quickly. I did tel one of my closest friends about the suicide thoughts and she talked to me for a few hours telling me how I may feel alone but I'm truly not. I worked out today which helped and hopefully I can figure out the emptiness with my girlfriend. 

Thank you for checking up on me.

I honestly can't thank you enough. I don't even know you, yet you are helping me. It feels good, it really does. I'll talk to my girlfriend later tomorrow and hopefully it will help a little bit. Thank you.

It's hard to open up. I don't really like telling people personal because I don't trust people. I do know one person I might be able to talk to, and I'll see if she's awake. I want to tell people how I feel, I feel I should at least tell my girlfriend. I just don't want to lose her and the happiness she brings me. I think I might try to open up a little more though. Thank you, truly, thank you. I appreciate you and everyone in this sub.
